newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metal prices improve on industrial demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian metal prices improve on industrial demand.

text.p: Prices of non-ferrous metals rose on Wednesday following a firm world trend and improved demand from industrial consumers, dealers said.
Ready copper gained 75 rupees to 13,500 rupees per quintal. Zinc rose 50 rupees per quintal to 7,900 rupees. Tin improved by 200 rupees to 31,200 rupees per quintal.
Nickel moved up 300 rupees to 36,100 rupees per quintal. Aluminium and lead, however, were unchanged at 7,450 rupees per quintal and 7,550 rupees per quintal.
"Demand for metals revived after two days' lacklustre trading," said a dealer.
